# Multi Agent Debates by Delibora

> Multi Agent Debates is a workspace for structured multi-agent AI deliberation, built by Delibora. Configure 2–100 reasoning agents across 10 purpose-built discussion formats and inspect the transcript, run trail, and format-specific output.

Site: https://multiagentdebates.com
Contact: mad@multiagentdebates.com
RSS: https://multiagentdebates.com/research/feed.xml

## Main

- [Home](https://multiagentdebates.com/): Product landing page — formats, capabilities, science foundation, use cases, beta waitlist
- [Research hub](https://multiagentdebates.com/research): Practical guides on multi-agent debate and LLM reasoning
- [Glossary](https://multiagentdebates.com/glossary): Definitions for multi-agent debate, M-MAD, CoT-SC, Degeneration of Thought, and related LLM reasoning terms

## Research articles

- [When to Use Multi-Agent Debate vs Self-Consistency](https://multiagentdebates.com/research/multi-agent-debate-vs-self-consistency): Research-backed comparison of CoT-SC and MAD — benchmarks, cost analysis, failure modes, hybrid playbook
- [How to Red-Team Ideas with Multi-Agent Debate](https://multiagentdebates.com/research/red-team-ideas-multi-agent-debate): Adversarial AI deliberation for stress-testing claims, messaging, and strategy before they ship

## Discussion formats

- Decision stress-test — 2 opposing agents; decision memo
- Expert panel — 3–5 experts; key insights without a verdict
- Judged debate — 2 debaters plus Arbiter; scored verdict
- 1:1 Human Dialogue — 2 Worker-backed LLMs; private-chat transcript
- Team Battle — 2 saved Teams plus fixed Arbiter; five-dimension scorecard and verdict
- Shark Tank — 2–4 Workers; cited pitch scorecard and verdict
- Focus group — 4–12 Workers; themes and verified quotes
- TribeMind — 12–50 synthetic participants; metrics and Observer report
- Idea Tournament — 4–16 ideas and 1–5 judges; champion spec and kill cards
- Custom discussion — configurable protocol, participants, models, runtime, evidence, notifications, and output

## Product capabilities

- 2–100 agents, with format-specific participant limits for specialized workflows
- Reusable Workers, Teams, Personas, and Playbooks
- Evidence Packs and optional internet research for Truth-Seeking Debate
- Lab Experiments that sweep sampling parameters and evaluate hidden child-run transcripts
- OpenRouter and LM Studio model routes with configurable fallbacks
- Live human intervention in running or paused discussions
- Turn, wall-clock runtime, and observed-cost limits
- Persisted transcripts, run logs, token and cost metadata, and portable JSON exports
- In-app notifications with optional Resend email delivery
- Durable Supabase-backed workers for discussions, pitches, Focus Groups, TribeMind, evidence, and research

## Use cases

Decision stress-testing, expert review, adversarial debate, AI-to-AI dialogue, team competition, pitch evaluation, moderated qualitative research, synthetic-audience simulation, and idea selection

## Scientific foundation

The platform's debate workflows are informed by published multi-agent research including Du et al. (ICML 2024), Liang et al. (EMNLP 2024), Feng et al. M-MAD (ACL 2025), Khan et al. (ICML 2024 Best Paper), Choi et al. Debate or Vote (NeurIPS 2025), and related work.
